doclang.text: Please read the manual before operating

doclang.heading: 1. Preface
doclang.text: Dear users, thank you for purchasing our products! Before installing the machine, please read the user manual to ensure the proper operation and use of the machine.

In order to protect your rights and interests, please check whether the machine is damaged or missing parts when receiving the machine. Please contact us If you have any problems during operation, we will try our best to provide services in the shortest time.
doclang.heading: 2.Safety advice !
doclang.table:
·
Please use purified water with a TDS under 20 mg/L, otherwise, it may affect the stable operation and service life of the equipment!
·
If the machine water tank is not used for 48 hours, please clean it. If no flow in the water pipe system for 5 days, please clean the device connecting to water supply
·
If the refrigeration equipment is left idle for a long period, please turn it off, defrost, clean, dry, and leave the door open to prevent mold growth inside the unit.
·
The machine can only be used indoors!
·
Keep the machine away from splashing!
·
Do not clean the equipment with water spray!
·
The equipment should be placed in a horizontal position.
·
The equipment can only be installed where it can be maintained and operated by trained personnel.
·
Please input the correct voltage according to the nameplate of the machine, and connect the ground wire before installation!
·
Do not operate or store equipment near heat and gas sources. Avoid splashing the machine with water!
·
The machine cannot be placed outdoors. Please choose our outdoor products for outdoor placement. Our company will not be responsible for equipment damage and personal injury caused by improper placement and operation!
·
The power supply of the equipment must be disconnected before cleaning and maintenance!
·
Do not drag the cable when unplugging!
·
Do not put the machine and power cable in water!
·
Do not tilt the machine when installing or moving!
·
（ IEC ） This device is not suitable for individuals with decreased physical, sensory, or mental abilities, or lacking experience and knowledge (including children), unless supervised or guided by personnel responsible for their safety. Children should be monitored to ensure that they do not touch this equipment. （ EN ） Children aged 8 and above, as well as individuals with decreased physical, sensory, or mental abilities, or lacking experience and knowledge, may use this equipment if they receive guidance on its use in a safe manner under supervision and are aware of the dangers involved. Children are not allowed to operate this device. Unsupervised children are not allowed to perform cleaning and user maintenance.

doclang.heading: 6.1 Preparations before installation
6.1.1 Attentions before installation
Environment requirement:
doclang.list:
＊Do not expose to rain
＊ Operating temperature: 5 - 4 3 ℃
＊Install on flat ground, no puddle and dirt
doclang.heading: P o w e r s u p p l y ：
doclang.list:
＊Must connect ground wire
＊220-240V~ 50Hz power supply
＊In the power supply line, the wire diameter of the live wire (L) and the neutral wire (N) shall not be less than 2.5 square millimeters
doclang.heading: 6.1.2 Installation distance requirements
doclang.text: The distance between the rear of the machine and the wall should be more than 20 cm. The air outlet on top of the machine should be more than 50 cm away from the surrounding objects. Otherwise, it will seriously affect the cooling of the refrigeration system and cause damage.
doclang.heading: 6.1.3 Adjust casters
doclang.text: Transport the machine to the location with forklift. The machine needs to be installed in a dry room without strong light. Place the machine stably by adjusting the casters.
Adjust the lower adjusting nut to drop the mat to the ground, to fix the machine position, turn the fixing nut upwards.

doclang.text: Use the screw to fix the packing table from inside the door.

doclang.heading: 7.3.3 SMB
doclang.text: SMB is a system used to control the coffee extraction process, and its parameters can be set through the machine backend and the PC end. By changing its parameters, the flow rate and pressure during coffee extraction can be adjusted, thereby affecting the flavor, acidity, oil content, and extraction rate of coffee concentrate. The system contains 6 variables (as shown in the figure below)

picture.heading: Grinding level
picture.text: Adjust on machine or PC backend

doclang.text: Adjust the grinding bean thickness by turning the grinding level knob. The smaller the value, the finer the grinding beans (Default setting particle diameter 0.35mm)
Coffee bean amount (set by operator, default is 18）
coffee extraction amount

picture.text: Adjust on machine or PC backend

doclang.heading: Coffee cake pressing level （default is 8 or 9）
doclang.text: Upper pressure limit during coffee extraction (default is 8 or 9）Higher pressure can make the concentrated liquid more rich in oil
Upper limit of flow rate during coffee extraction (default is 5 or 6）A lower flow rate can improve the coffee extraction rate

The standard values for coffee extraction flow rate and extraction pressure that we usually recommend are: 18 grams of coffee powder, at a pressure of 9 bar, for about 30 seconds, to extract 60ml of concentrated solution (which is more balanced in terms of extraction rate, oil, and production time). However, due to differences in coffee bean variety, roasting degree, taste requirements, etc., it is necessary to adjust the SMB parameters to achieve perfect extraction effect.
During making a coffee, the 2 numbers on the machine screen indicating time and pressure from left to right
doclang.heading: 7.3.4 SMB settings
doclang.text: Case 1: When the coffee liquid has less oil, light color, sour taste, and low-pressure value displayed on the screen, it indicates that the coffee has not been fully extracted and the extraction rate needs to be increased. One or more of the following can be adjusted to obtain coffee with richer oil.
increase pressing pressure

Case 2: When the coffee liquid has too much oil, dark color, bitter taste, long extraction time, or even reports a flow failure state, it indicates that the coffee has been over extracted and the extraction rate needs to be reduced. One or more of the following can be adjusted to obtain coffee with a more balanced flavor.
decrease pressing pressure
Case 3: When the extraction flow rate and extraction pressure are appropriate, the flavor of coffee can also be influenced by changing the amount of extraction solution.

picture.text: 50-60ml of concentrated solution is extracted, at which point the flavor is more balanced. When it is less than 40ml, the concentration of coffee is higher, there is more oil, and the acidity will increase.
When it exceeds 60ml, the concentration of coffee decreases, acidity decreases, and bitterness increases.

doclang.text: Tip: If you want to change the parameters, it needs to be operated by an experienced barista. While observing the extraction pressure and flow rate, taste the flavor of the coffee liquid to ultimately achieve the desired taste.

doclang.text: When powder, liquid and topping material inventory ≤ sold out value, products contain the material will be sold out. When beans, fresh milk, lids and cups inventory ≤alert value, alert prompt will be displayed on PC back end, no soldout sign will be displayed.
doclang.heading: 7.8 Machine settings
7.8.1 UI settings
doclang.text: Login operator account, machine management, machine list, view, UI settings, add and edit to upload pictures.
doclang.list: l You can upload up to 5 banner posters, and only 1 picture for other icons.
doclang.heading: 7.8.2 Advertising settings
doclang.text: On PC back end: Login operator account, machine management, machine list, view, advertising settings, and add pictures and videos according to the format requirement. Parameter setting is for enable and disable AD function.
doclang.list:
l This setting is for stand by advertising, video and slides supported.
l Only upload jpg and ma4, up to 5 videos and pictures supported. Size: 1920*1080 or 1080*1920.
l Stand by duration: How long the machine will start to display advertising without people touching the screen. Minimum 30s.
l You can edit and delete advertising materials.
doclang.heading: 7.8.3 Audio settings
doclang.text: On PC back end: Login operator account, Machine management--Machine list--View--Audio settings Click add--choose audio track--click upload audio file.
doclang.list:
l Multi language: click audio management-add-select device language and upload audio file.
l Support mp3 format.
doclang.heading: 7.8.4 Copy machine
doclang.text: On PC back end: Login operator account, Machine management--Machine list--Copy to another machines. Check 2 machines and save.
doclang.list:
l Machines with same model and configuration can be copied with each other.
l Channel, product classification, product information, recipe, UI and AD will be copied to the selected machine. Machine details, inventory，orders and activities will not be copied.
doclang.heading: 7.8.5 Parameter settings
doclang.text: On PC back end: Login operator account, Machine management--Machine list--Parameter setting. You can set machine aliases, machine languages, machine address, machine and operator password, milk shelf life, enable/disable temperature monitor and cart, set product names.
doclang.list:
l Machine password access to all machine settings, operator password access to machine setting page, excluding product recipe, calibration, sale data and password modification.
l You can change machine password in machine back end, but operator password can not be changed on machine.
l Temperature monitor is only for the model with refrigerator. You can check temperature data in temperature monitor log.
l Products information is where you can change nutrition facts.
doclang.heading: 7.9 Campaign settings
7.9.1 Buy one and get one for free
doclang.text: After buying a campaign product , there will be a QR code on the upper right corner of the screen, scanning it and your phone will receive a pickup code. Enter the code on the machine to get a free drink. On PC back end:
doclang.list:
l Login operator account, sales management, activity management and add new campaign.
l Select campaign machine scope.
l After check the machine, the products of the machine will be displayed, select a campaign product, then click add, select the corresponding free drink and save.
doclang.heading: 7.9.1 Buy one and get one for free
doclang.text: Note: 1.Campaign information will be displayed on customer's mobile phone.
doclang.list:
2.
Machine identify activity products through product number, please pay attention if the product numbers in the activity are consistent.
3.
The SMS received by the customer shows the validity period of the activity. After setting the end time of the activity, do not change it.
4.
To use SMS services, customers need to purchase SMS packages first. If SMS packages are not configured, customers will not receive SMS messages after scanning the code.
doclang.heading: 7.9.2 Pick up code
doclang.text: On PC back end: Login operator account, Sales management, create pick up code.
doclang.list:
l There are universal code and designated code
Universal code：applicable for all products of all machines under the same account.
doclang.text: Designated code：applicable for specific product of specific machine under the same account. Product is identified by product number.
doclang.list:
l Pick up code generated by PC back end has no expiration date and will become invalid upon use.
l You can check pick up code information and export.
l Before setting up the activity, please purchase the SMS package. If the SMS package is not configured, customers will not receive the SMS after scanning the code.
doclang.text: You can batch generate universal pick up code and you can also send by sms to customers.
For designated code, select machine--select product--select scope--batch generate/send by sms and generate.
doclang.heading: 7.10 Data
7.10.1 Sales data
doclang.text: PC back end: Login operator account to view sales data and refund records in My earnings
doclang.list:
l Click order information to check order, and refund for certain payment methods.
l Click 'refund' to refund the order, and the money will be returned to the payment account(only for certain payment methods).
l You can view refund records in refund management.
doclang.text: Automatic refund: production failed, the system will refund immediately, if power off during production, the system will refund in 15 mins.
Manual refund: click refund button in PC back end, refresh the page after 2 mins to check the status. Machine backend: tap equipment test, sales data and view.
doclang.heading: 7.10.2 Replenishment and consumption log
doclang.text: PC back end: Login operator account, machine management, machine log information to view the log information, you can export consumption log with in 3 months.
doclang.heading: 7.11 Status
doclang.text: PC back end: Login operator account, machine list, machine basic information, machine log information to view the details.
doclang.list:
l Main page：click the number on upper left corner to navigate to the machine status list, click status information to navigate to the basic information page.
l Machine basic information: the status texts will turn red when abnormal.
l Machine log information: machine management, machine log information, to view online/offline log, failure machine, insufficient material information, temperature monitor log, some of the log can be exported within 10 days.
doclang.text: When the machine and back-end display status are inconsistent due to network reasons, you can click the "Machine Status Synchronization" button in the 'equipment status" to synchronize the status when net work condition gets better.
doclang.heading: PC end：
doclang.list:
l Enter machine backend, check machine status, abnormal status will turn red.
l Enter machine backend, machine status, machine status list, when abnormal, the icon will turn red with notice.
doclang.text: When the machine and back-end display status are inconsistent due to network reasons, you can click the "Machine Status Synchronization" button in the 'equipment status" to synchronize the status when net work condition gets better.
doclang.heading: 7.12 Remote control
doclang.text: On PC backend: Login operator backend, machine management, machine list, view, machine control.
doclang.list:
l I/O board restart: for machines using I/O board.
l APK restart: Remote restart machine apk.
l Open door: remote open the machine door
l Open pick-up door: remote open machine pick-up door.
l Close pick-up door: remote close machine pick-up door.
l Cup holder to pick-up position and open pick-up door: in case of power cut or other emergency condition resulting unable to pick up the drink, please tap this button, the cup holder will move to pick-up position and open the pick-up door. After pick up the drink, tap confirm button, the cup holder will move back to original position and close the pick-up door
l Machine standard cleaning: remote clean the machine.
l Milk pipe descaling cleaning: remote descaling clean the milk pipe, apply to fresh milk model
l Open machine door and enter back end: remote open the door and enter machine back end.
l Machine Status Synchronization：when the computer can not receive the machine status update due to poor network condition, tap this button to update.
doclang.heading: 7.13 Sub-account
doclang.text: On PC back end:
Step1: Login operator account, Permission management--Role management, add new role and save, then check the permissions for the new role and save.

picture.caption: Step 2: Permission management-user management, add information and save. then check the new sub account, machine authorities and save.

doclang.list: l You can give sub account limited or full access to the machine.
doclang.text: Reset password: check account and click reset password and confirm. Default pass word is 123456.
doclang.heading: 7.14 Change account information
doclang.text: On PC back end: Login operator account, click user information on upper right corner to change username and password.

doclang.heading: 8.2 Daily cleaning and maintenance
8.2.1 Clean Canister and nozzle
doclang.list:
l Clean canister: Pull the mixer cover, turn canister nozzle upward then lift to remove the canister. Empty the canister before cleaning and dry it before installation.
l Clean nozzle: Turn and pull the nozzle to remove
doclang.text: Note: 1. Due to factors such as environmental temperature, humidity, material thickness, and sugar content, the degree of moisture and agglomeration at the powder outlet may be different. It is recommended that you regularly clean the powder outlet based on the actual situation to avoid blockage. (Daily cleaning is required in special circumstances) !
doclang.list:
2.
standard the machine after refilling powder(refer to machine standard cleaning).
doclang.heading: 8.2.2 Clean mixers
doclang.list:
1.
Lift the mixer to remove, turn the base clockwise and pull to remove (Pic 1,2). Weekly cleaning recommended.
2.
When installing after cleaning, install the surface with protrusions on the impeller corresponding to the position of the shaft plane, install the mixer assembly, and insert the water outlet into place (Pic.3)
doclang.heading: 8.2.3 Clean pump tubes
doclang.list:
l Press the metal button on the quick plug to remove the pipe and clean.
l Connect the cleaning pipe with the syrup inlet, and press the corresponding pump button to clean syrup pipe.
l Please clean the unused pulp pump in a timely manner. If there is pulp condensation at the junction of the pipe, soak it in hot water to soften it before performing regular cleaning.
doclang.heading: 8.2.4 Clean pick-up compartment
doclang.text: Lift the clips on the both sides of the compartment and open to clean.
doclang.heading: 8.2.5 Clean consumable compartment
doclang.list:
l Enter machine backend to unlock the door.
l Lift the door to clean.
doclang.heading: 8.2.6 Replace barreled water
doclang.list:
l After the water shortage prompt appears, the water barrel needs to be replaced. After replacement, press the "Water Pump Reset" button on the water pump to automatically start pumping water from barrel No. 1.
l If the water shortage lasts for a long time, causing insufficient water for ice maker, it is necessary to press the "→" button twice on the screen of the ice maker to replenish water.
doclang.heading: 8.2.7 Machine cleaning
doclang.text: On machine back end-equipment test:
doclang.list:
l Standard cleaning: press the button and machine will clean pipes automatically.
l Regular cleaning: set a time then enable, the machine will clean at the certain time.
doclang.heading: 8.2.8 Ice dispensing and cleaning of ice maker
8.2.10 Daily cleaning for other parts
doclang.text: It is recommended to dump the waste grounds bucket and waste water bucket daily, and other parts can be directly wiped with a clean cloth. After all cleaning is completed, you can enter the machine back end to perform a standard cleaning of the machine.
doclang.list:
l Cleaning method: When the machine door is closed or fully opened (not half open to prevent the components on the door from getting wet), press "Standard Cleaning", and the machine will automatically clean each pipeline. Do not perform any other operations during the cleaning process;
l Cleaning frequency: It is recommended that maintenance personnel perform a standard cleaning once a day to prevent bacterial growth and pipeline blockage.
doclang.heading: 8.3 Regular cleaning and maintenance
8.3.1 Grinder nozzle cleaning
doclang.text: After prolonged use, there will be coffee powder residue in the pipeline, and severe residue can cause blockage, obstruction of the grinder motor operation, and damage! Regular cleaning is required, and the method is as follows: !
doclang.list:
l Remove the brewer and use a cleaning brush to clean the inner wall upwards, keeping the pipeline unobstructed.
l Weekly cleaning recommended
doclang.heading: 8.3.2 Grinder cleaning
doclang.text: After prolonged use of the grinder, there will be lumps and residues of coffee powder inside, which can cause poor powder output. In severe cases, the grinder motor may be blocked and even damaged! Therefore, regular cleaning is required, and the method is as follows: !
doclang.list:
l Cleaning method：
1.
Remove the coffee bean hopper, dismantle the brewer, put a cup to the bottom of the powder dropping pipe, long press the "Coffee Bean 1" test button, and grind out the remaining coffee beans (Figure 1, 2) ；
2.
Place appropriate amount of cleaning tablet (refer to the tablet instructions) into the feeding port of the grinder, grind out all the tablets, and use a cup catch them (Figure 3)
3.
Add appropriate amount of coffee beans into the feeding port of the grinder, grind all the coffee beans and catch with a cup. Repeat the process multiple times until there are no cleaning tablet residue in the powder;
4.
Clean the powder dropping pipe and install hopper and brewer.
l Cleaning frequency: clean every 1000 coffee drinks recommended.

picture.text: Do not put your hand in grinder

doclang.heading: 8.3.3 Brewer descaling cleaning
doclang.list:
l Cleaning method: when the machine door is closed or wide open(to prevent components from splashing), make sure there is sufficient water, put the cleaning tablets into the brewing chamber, tap 'descaling cleaning'，the cleaning duration is about 16 minutes. During the above cleaning process, do not carry out any other operations, and the maintenance personnel shall not leave the machine,｛please use special cleaning tablet[Main ingredients: sodium carbonate (＜35%), sodium percarbonate (＜22%), sulfamic acid (＜20%)], please purchase separately｝
l Monthly cleaning recommended
doclang.heading: 8.3.4 Air inlet cleaning
doclang.list:
l Clean ice maker filter mesh: lift to remove the mesh and clean, dry it before install.
l Clean the sponge: Open the ventilation magnetic door, take out the sponge, clean it, and let it dry before use.
l Cleaning frequency: clean every 2 months, according to the actual use.
doclang.heading: 8.3.5 Machine sterilization cleaning
doclang.list: l Step1：Preparation (empty water)
doclang.text: 1.Put chlorine dioxide (tablets or solution) into approximately 18-liter barrels of water according to the concentration requirements specified in the instructions, and wait for sufficient dissolution before use.
doclang.list:
2.Perform the operation of discharging residual materials. Clean the pump tubes twice, each time for 10 seconds (refer to the cleaning method for the pump tubes).
3.Perform the operation of emptying the remaining ice in the ice maker (refer to the method of ice removal and cleaning in the ice maker), and then turn off the power of the ice maker.
4.Perform the water tank emptying operation (turn off the water supply pump switch, open the drain valves of the ice maker water tank and coffee machine water tank, and close the drain valves after the water is emptied).
doclang.text: 5.Empty the boiler(refer to emptying the boiler)
doclang.list:
l Step 2: sterilization cleaning (Make the disinfectant flow through all pipelines)
1.Insert all water supply pump inlet pipes into the prepared chlorine dioxide disinfectant solution, turn on the water supply pump switch, and restart the machine.
2.Wait for self check.
3.Standard clean the machine third times (refer machine cleaning).
4.Clean ice maker once (refer to ice maker ice dispensing and cleaning).
5.Clean pump tubes twice, 10 seconds each time.

l Step 3: clean disinfectant
1.Perform 3,4, and 5 in step 1.
2.Connect purified water and open the water pump, restart the machine.
3.Wait for self check.
4.Perform 3,4, and 5 in step 2
l Step 4: finish sterilization cleaning (make sure zero residue of disinfectant)
1.Perform 3,4 and 5 in step 1.
2.Restart the machine and wait for self check.
3.Sterilization cleaning finished, the machine is ready to use.
l Cleaning frequency: clean every 15-30 days recommended.
l This operation is accompanied by video instructions. Please consult after-sale personal

doclang.heading: 10.1 Storage
doclang.text: Do not store the machine under low temperature, water pipeline might freeze. If you want to place the machine under low temperature, please empty the ice maker and water pipeline(refer to ice maker ice dispensing and cleaning). If the water pipeline is frozen, do not power on the machine, please place the machine under room temperature to unfreeze. !
doclang.heading: 10.1.1 Empty the water pipes
doclang.list:
1.
Discharge ice in ice maker(refer to ice maker ice dispensing and cleaning), turn off the ice maker power.
2.
Empty water tang(s witch off water feeding pump, switch on the outlet valve of ice maker and the machine water tank. After empty, switch them off ).
3.
Empty the boiler: s witch on the water outlet valve, enter machine back end, tap "empty water pipeline", tap "confirm" and corresponding buttons, input "64873251", tap "confirm.
4.
After water is empty, switch off the water outlet valve and shut down the power.
doclang.heading: 10.2 Transportation
doclang.list:
l Before transportation, the ice maker and waterway must be emptied, and then pack the machine.
l It is recommended to use the original packaging and pallets to pack the machine before transportation
